entities.summary: Deborah Loewenberg Ball is an educational researcher noted for her work in mathematics instruction and the mathematical preparation of teachers. From 2017 to 2018 she served as president of the American Educational Research Association. She served as dean of the School of Education at the University of Michigan from 2005 to 2016, and she currently works as William H. Payne Collegiate Professor of education. Ball directs TeachingWorks, a major project at the University of Michigan to redesign the way that teachers are prepared for practice, and to build materials and tools that will serve the field of teacher education broadly.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Deborah Loewenberg Ball's work on teacher preparation and mathematics instruction has had a significant impact on education policy and practice in North America. Her leadership roles at the University of Michigan have shaped the field of teacher education, with her project TeachingWorks providing resources for thousands of educators.
